in_sanskrit.name: Beeresh

It is the name of the God who is the presiding deity of all craftsmen and artisans. Beeresh is often depicted with a plough, a pair of compasses, and a carpenter's square. He is also known as the God of cows, as cows are considered sacred in Hinduism and are used for various purposes in agriculture and religious rituals.
